arabic text: AY MUSLAMAAN KASH SOCHA HOTA KAY MOHAMMAD K\nA NAWASA HAI YEH
english translation text: O Muslims,\nhad you only remembered that this is Muhammad’s grandson.

arabic text: HALATE SAJDA ME HAI BEKASO MAJBOOR BHI HAI\nAUR KAHI ROZ KA PYAASA HAI YEH
english translation text: He lies helpless in prostration,\nand has been thirsty for many days.

arabic text:
AQL HEYRAAN THI ISAY BANDA KAY REHMAN KAHEY
NOKAY NAYZA PE ISE BOLTA QURAN KAHEY
YA TO RAB HAI JOKAY BANDE SA NAZAR AATA HAI
GHAR HAI INSAAN TO KHUDA SA HAI YEH
english translation text:
Reason was bewildered:
should it call him a servant or the Merciful’s sign?
Should it call him the speaking Qur’an upon the spear?
He appears as a human being, yet reflects the light of God.

arabic text:
BOLI ZAINAB ZULM SHABBIR PE DHANAY WALO
PATHARON KAY TALE MAYYAT KO CHUPANE WALO
HAY KAANDHEY PE UTHATHEY THE JINHE KHATME RUS
UL
MERE US BHAI KA LAASHA HAI YEH
english translation text:
Zainab said: O you who inflicted cruelty upon Shabbir,
you who hid his body beneath stones—
this is the body of my brother
whom the Seal of the Prophets
once carried upon his shoulders.

arabic text:
JIS KA GHAZI NA RAHA AUR ALI AKBAR NA BACHA
BHAI KI LAASH PAY KHULKE JISAY RONAY NA DIYA
AAJ MATAM SARE BAZAAR JO HUM KARTE HAY
ISSI ZAINAB KA DILASA HAI YEH
english translation text:
His Ghazi is gone, and Ali Akbar did not survive.
His sister was not even allowed to weep openly over his body.
The mourning we perform in every marketplace today
is a comfort to that very Zainab.

arabic text:
SAYYEDON KA BHARA GHAR BAAR JHALAYA KYUN HAI
BIBIYON KO SARE BAZAAR PHIRAYA KYUN HAI
TUNE TOH YEH BHI NA SOCHA KAI JO QAIDI HAI BANE
PAAK ZAHRA KA ASASA HAI YEH
english translation text:
Why did you burn the full household of the Sayyids?
Why did you parade the women through the marketplaces?
Did you not realise that those taken captive
were Zahra’s most precious trust?

arabic text: MAIN HUN ZAINAB MUJHE HAIDER KO SAMAJTA KYUN\nHAIN
english translation text: I am Zainab—why do you fail\nto recognise Haider in me?

arabic text: SUN KAY KHUTBA MERA MAL'OON BIGARTA KYUN HAI\nBOLI ZAINAB KAY YEH KHUTBA HI NA HI SUN AY YAZID\nPAAK QUR'AN KA KHULASA HAI YEH
english translation text: Why does the accursed ruler tremble on hearing my sermon?\nZainab said: Yazid, this is no ordinary speech;\nit is the essence of the Holy Qur’an.
